_note: Curated model list (WORKORDER_01 section 3). Model behaviour must never be hard-coded elsewhere in the application. Every mlx entry is pinned to an explicit commit SHA: the mlx-community namespace holds community MLX conversions of upstream models, not the original publishers' repositories, so downloads must be reproducible rather than tracking whatever main contains. Bumping a pin is a deliberate edit. 'verified' means a real inference has been run through the application's own provider code.
_note_provider_options: 'provider_options' is merged into the request body by the cloud providers, untouched. It is how a model declares its own request shape without a branch in Python: Claude Sonnet 5 takes thinking {type: adaptive} and returns 400 for budget_tokens, while Haiku 4.5 is the other way round.
_note_capabilities: 'supports_temperature', 'supports_thinking_budget' and 'output_headroom_tokens' are per-model capabilities, NOT inferences the provider makes from the rest of the request. Whether a model accepts a sampling temperature is a fact about that model: one may reason and still accept it, another may reject it with no thinking at all. Declare it here and the provider obeys. They default to the local-model answer (temperature yes, no manual thinking budget, no extra output room), so only a model that differs needs to say so. 'output_headroom_tokens' was called 'reasoning_reserve_tokens' until it was measured: on Luna, reasoning is 14-334 tokens while a long answer wanted 2179 against a 1200 default cap, so the field is really headroom for the whole output and is now named for what it does.
_note_cloud_context: The cloud context_policy values are a COST budget, not a context limit. Claude Sonnet 5's real window is 1M tokens; at $2 per 1M input tokens a turn near a 120000-token budget costs about $0.24 of input alone, every turn, for a child changing one line of a game. 48000/36000 keeps a turn near $0.10 on Sonnet and half that on Haiku while still giving three times the room of the largest local model. Raise it deliberately, knowing the per-turn price, not because the window allows it.

models.name: Qwen3 4B
models.verified_notes: Phase 1: loads offline from local snapshot, 92.5 tok/s, 2.61 GB resident, 16/16 tool-call selection in the recommended configuration. See SPIKES.md.

models.name: Claude
models.notes: Adaptive thinking, and no manual budget_tokens. Temperature is omitted because this model does not accept a sampling temperature -- declared, not inferred.
models.verified_notes: SPIKES.md section 11: real request through the application's own provider code. Streamed text, a run_project tool call, and usage (38 in / 36 out) all returned. Both capability flags were PROBED by contradicting them: the service rejected a temperature and rejected budget_tokens, so both 'false' values are measured rather than assumed.

models.name: Claude Haiku
models.notes: The cheaper rung, and the one to use for integration testing where cost matters more than judgement. Present mainly so the provider layer is exercised against BOTH Anthropic request shapes: this entry takes a manual budget_tokens, which Sonnet 5 rejects with a 400.
models.verified_notes: SPIKES.md section 11: real request through the application's own provider code. Streamed text, a run_project tool call, and usage (60 in / 109 out) all returned. budget_tokens was ACCEPTED here and rejected on Sonnet 5, which is the split this entry exists to prove. The budget is 1024 rather than 4000 because max_tokens must exceed it and thinking tokens are billed as output -- see _make_room_for_thinking.

models.name: OpenAI
models.notes: Built against the Responses API. Image GENERATION is a separate model (gpt-image-2.5-flare) and decision D6; it is deliberately not a catalogue entry, because a catalogue entry is something that answers a conversation and an image model is not. Note that supports_images here means this model could READ a picture -- it does not mean Open Nest sends it one. See provider.IMAGE_INPUT_IMPLEMENTED.
models.verified_notes: SPIKES.md section 11, real request through the application's own provider code on 2026-09-21: connect 2.3s, 78 chars streamed, usage 34 in / 24 out, run_project tool call assembled. supports_temperature was PROBED by contradicting it and the service refused a temperature, so 'false' is measured. output_headroom_tokens 2000 was measured on gpt-5-mini rather than on luna, which barely reasoned on the test prompt (24 output tokens for 78 characters); it is a ceiling, not a spend, so it costs nothing when unused.
